question: An electric dipole is completely enclosed by an irregular closed surface. What is the net electric flux through the surface? Give the reason.

options.A: $\frac{2q}{\varepsilon_0}$, because both charges of the dipole add up
options.B: $\frac{q}{\varepsilon_0}$, because only the positive charge contributes
options.D: $0$, because the net enclosed charge of the dipole is zero
